entities.summary: Verdelho is a white wine grape grown throughout Portugal, though most associated with the island of Madeira, and also gives its name to one of the four main types of Madeira wine. At the turn of the 20th century, it was the most widely planted white grape in Madeira. Verdelhos was a freguesia of Portugal in Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
